_source: architecture_v3_specs/03_combinations.md WT_RULE_01–02 + 07_combinations_detailed/03_attrwt.md. Both workbook rules retained. File 11 A/B/C tier mix encoded as priority_when on WT_RULE_01, not as renamed/split rule_ids.

_decisions.completeness: Exactly two workbook rules: WT_RULE_01 (temporal TRUE) and WT_RULE_02 (temporal NULL / insufficient dates). No WT_RULE_01A/B/C rename that drops WT_RULE_01.
_decisions.tier_mix_ranking: When T01 is TRUE: ORTHO T1+CARDIO T1 → A; mixed T1+T2 → B; T2+T2 → C. Still one rule_id WT_RULE_01.
_decisions.temporal_null: WT_RULE_02 fires when T01 cannot be evaluated (missing/uncertain chronology). Workbook Priority B.
_decisions.temporal_false: Confirmed CARDIO-before-ORTHO is documented below as a non-pass case — not a dropped rule; workbook never defined a FALSE branch as a positive ATTRwt rule.

combinations.note: Canonical ATTRwt rule: ORTHO first evidence precedes CARDIO first evidence. No hard universal year cutoff. Temporal order strengthens priority but does not create another bucket.
Same ORTHO+CARDIO pair when date quality is insufficient to prove sequence. Ranks below WT_RULE_01.

_notes: SATISFIED_FALSE (CARDIO before ORTHO): workbook defines no positive ATTRwt rule. ATTR_COMMON AC01 may still fire; no ATTRwt combination output.
ORTHO+NEURO and CARDIO+NEURO are deliberately not ATTRwt rules — they may pass ATTR_COMMON (AC04/AC07) only.
